pages.text: Ignite a black hole in an $(l:multiblocks/event_horizon)Event Horizon Reactor$() and feed it anything for power. Near it, the $(item)Singularity Processor$() turns one raw ore into five ingots, with rare drops.$(br2)$(#FF5050)Do not walk into the field.$()
The Event Horizon Reactor holds a black hole that eats items for power.
